reason: B is the stronger proposal because it defines a specific refractory-HEA baseline, a controlled 5 at.% substitution, relevant high-temperature/irradiation comparisons, and a clear falsification test. Its claimed 20–30% gain and reduced scattering are weakly supported and may be physically optimistic, but it is more testable and plausible than adding 3–5 wt% graphene, which is likely to react, agglomerate, or form high-resistance interfaces at 700–1000 °C.
